info.title: Finance OS API
info.description: B0 contract-first architecture. ONLY /health/live, /health/ready and /v1/meta are implemented. Protected finance routes are PLANNED, not operational. All amounts are integer minor units. B1 adds separately authenticated local development services for workspace accounts, manually posted double-entry journals, and reconciliation. Password login is explicitly disabled in production. Unimplemented routes retain PLANNED status. B3: user-estimated income, immutable due obligations, posted-manual-expense settlement evidence, and indicative non-provider-verified cashflow forecasts. No automatic provider payments.
